cases.prompt: How do I build a shared value animation with Reanimated in my Expo app?
expectations: Reads and follows the relevant sub-skill file at references/animations/SKILL.md.
Covers core hooks such as useSharedValue and useAnimatedStyle.
Mentions animation functions like withSpring or withTiming where relevant.

cases.prompt: I want pinch-to-zoom on an image in React Native. What library and pattern should I use?
expectations: Directs to the sub-skill at references/gestures/SKILL.md.
Recommends React Native Gesture Handler (GestureDetector with a pinch gesture) rather than PanResponder.

cases.prompt: I'm building a chat feature with speech-to-text and text-to-speech in my React Native app. Where do I start?
expectations: Directs to the sub-skill at references/on-device-ai/SKILL.md.
Identifies that speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) map to the speech processing area of the on-device-ai sub-skill.

cases.prompt: My React Native app freezes while computing a big diff on the JS thread. How can I move it off the JS thread?
expectations: Directs to the sub-skill at references/multithreading/SKILL.md for react-native-worklets.
Mentions scheduleOnUI, scheduleOnRN, or createWorkletRuntime and Worker Runtimes for offloading computation from the JS thread.

cases.prompt: I'm trying to import an npm library inside a worklet and I keep getting 'Failed to get the SHA-1' errors. What's going on?
expectations: Recognizes this as react-native-worklets Bundle Mode setup.
Mentions the mandatory metro/metro-runtime patches and the babel bundleMode plugin option.

cases.prompt: I just opened this repo, it has react-native in package.json, and I'm about to edit some UI code. Anything I should do first?
expectations: States that this skill applies because the working directory has react-native/expo as a dependency and MUST be used before writing, reviewing, or debugging React Native code.
Reads the relevant sub-skill in the references/ folder before making changes.
